Poker.et: Borrowed from English poker, itself perhaps derived from German Pochspiel (pochen + Spiel).

Pokémon.et: Borrowed from Japanese ポケモン (Pokemon), a contraction of ポケットモンスター (Poketto Monsutā), itself from English pocket monster.

pökeln.et: From Pökel m (“brine”) + -en, from Middle Low German pekel f (“brine”). Ultimately perhaps from Latin *picco (“to sting”). Compare English pickle.
